rationale: The apparent 1.10 percent basis spread is source-supported. The raw source row is in the prior-period SOI block: fair value 2,889 divided by the December 31, 2024 net assets anchor 263,782 equals 1.095 percent, which rounds to the printed 1.10 percent. The same prior-period block total, 359,897 / 263,782, rounds to the printed 136.44 percent. The source value is therefore correct; the flag reflects use of the wrong basis/check context rather than a data error.
